## Problem

What gap or friction does this address? Name the problem, not the solution.

## Proposed change

What you propose. Substantive protocol changes are tracked as PRDs and admitted
through the eight-step PRD-006 A1 loop (see CONTRIBUTING.md and INTENT.md
"Admission criteria for changes"); this issue is the starting point.

## Alternatives considered

What else you weighed and why this is preferable.

## Scope

Which surfaces it touches (protocol docs, tools, schemas, skills) and whether it
is additive or breaking.
